# kindminds-mobile

## Project intent

Our goal is to create the mobile app version for this project https://github.com/Ayushparashar2005/newkindminds.git BUT the mobile app is actually quite different in the fact that it will be a sort of survival kit of disaster victims - Local based map, Local on device LLM, BitChat like bluetooth based communication system. So a fully local running app that can be used in situations of disasters where networks aren't so common.
